newsitem.title: philippines: Manila stock index plunges 4.15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila stock index plunges 4.15 pct.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange index plunged further in early trade on Tuesday with the main index falling to 2,719.69, down 117.62 points or 4.15 percent.
"It's a freefall," Edser Trinidad, an analyst at Peregrine Securities, said.
The across-the-board selldown was triggered by the poor first quarter income results of the Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co PLDT, the country's biggest telecom company.

Trinidad said the negative sentiment affected other stocks, particularly banking and property stocks which have been battered since the start of the month due to fears of rising bad debts and an impending property glut.
Industry leaders have been dismissing such concerns, but the fears persist. -- RAMONCITO DELA CRUZ (63 2) 841-8938 Fax 8176267
